The overview has been generated with Claude Opus 5.5, based on the overviews of Statutory duties and Citizens' rights and duties. The overview has not been reviewed manually. It is recommended that you check the content against the stated sources before using the overview for anything. 

Claude's comments on the file: The file tjenester_og_hendelser_opplaeringslopet.csv has 101 rows. It brings together 78 services, 62 individual events and 12 life events and business events. Each row is one link between an event and a service. It is saved with semicolon as separator and UTF-8, so that æøå display correctly when you open it in Norwegian Excel.	
How to read the file:One row is one link. The left side of the row describes the event and the life event it belongs to. The right side describes the service. The column «Relation (CPSV-AP-NO)» states which property the link is: «may trigger» or «may create need for».	
You follow the chains using IDs. The column «Service output may create event» points on to the next event. «Requires service» shows what must be done first. An example: the diploma (T-GS-12) creates H-GS-09, which triggers admission (T-VG-01).	
Education level and responsibility are in separate columns: education level (including «Across levels»), responsible actor, level of government, target group and appeal body.	

Additional information:	
* Certainty. All links are marked Assumed, because they are my derivation. Four services have no individual event of their own in the files and are linked directly to the life event: municipal school of arts, exemption on grounds of religion or belief, career guidance and private candidate examination.	
* What I checked against the legislation: I looked up 16 provisions in Lovdata through Digdir's law MCP. The data in the lookup tool is from 5 May 2026, so changes after that have not been captured.

The findings that changed or clarified the file:
* Appeal body in the Education Act. Education Act § 29-1 says that the ministry is the appeal body for individual decisions. For admission to upper secondary and choice of education programme and school, however, Public Administration Act § 28 applies. Appeals on admission therefore go to the county authority's appeal body, and I have corrected that in the file (§ 29-1). Assumed: That the County Governor handles the other appeals in practice is due to delegation. It is not stated in the text of the law.	
* Admission to higher education on the basis of prior learning is not a right. Universities and University Colleges Act § 8-2 says that the institutions «may» grant admission to applicants over 25 years of age (§ 8-2).	
* New service for practice candidates. The county authority decides whether the practice can be approved, and may in special cases approve shorter practice (ol. § 23-2). This has been added as a separate service (T-VO-06).	
* Correct trigger for Norwegian language training. The three-month deadline is counted from registration in the National Population Register in the municipality. The municipality issues the participant certificate, and the county authority is responsible for full-time pupils in upper secondary (Integration Act § 30).	
* Conditions for school environment cases. The case must have been raised with the principal, and at least one week must have passed, before the County Governor handles it (ol. § 12-6).	
* Requirements for notification about pupils with adaptation needs. The municipality's notification by 1 October requires consent from the pupil, and the expert assessment is carried out by the PPT in the county authority (forskr. § 4-21).	
* Two admission regulations. The current regulations (FOR-2017-01-06-13) are in force. The new admission regulations that the rights file is based on do not enter into force until 1 January 2027 (FOR-2025-09-11-1850).	
* These provisions confirmed what was in the files: ol. §§ 2-1, 5-1, 9-4 and 25-2, bhl. §§ 16 and 49, Integration Act § 12, forskr. § 6-2, Vocational Education Act § 16 and Folk High Schools Act § 16.	

What is still uncertain	
* 78 of the legal bases have not been verified. They are taken directly from your files and marked «Uploaded files (not verified)» in the column «Source of legal basis».	
* Some appeal bodies are guesses. Lånekassen, HK-dir and approval of kindergartens are marked Assumed.	
* The Lånekassen legal bases for higher education are not specified down to section, neither in the files nor by me.
* Event type from Digdir's vocabulary («decision made» or «data changed»).
* Transition, for example «Primary and lower secondary → upper secondary».
* Legal basis with Lovdata link, and whether the legal basis has been checked against Lovdata or only taken from the files.
* Note with deadlines and conditions.
